description: Test an HTML email (spam checker, client preview and compatibility): structure and compliance (alt text, unsubscribe, size), a per-client compatibility matrix (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Yahoo), a heuristic spam-risk estimate with reasons, and optional SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks for the sending domain. Static analysis, not a real inbox test.

domain.description: Sending domain, for example example.com, to check SPF, DKIM and DMARC

html.description: Full HTML source of the email (up to 200 KB)

subject.description: Subject line, used for spam heuristics

name: test_html_email
title: HTML Email Tester: Spam Check, Preview and Client Compatibility
